title: Unary words have logarithmic-space query languages
statement: For the function $g(n)=1^n$, both languages of encoded pairs consisting of $1^n$ and the binary representation of an index—one accepting when the indexed bit of $g(n)$ is $1$, the other when the index is less than $|g(n)|$—are decidable in logarithmic space.
